amount_cents.description: BRL amount for machine calculation. A fixed-price product needs this to be ordered. text remains the display price.

oneOf.description: Display price, for example R$ 40. No payment is made by this API.

description.description: Plain text. Clients never make links clickable.

CatalogItemInput.description: Full item replacement. Scheduling fields apply only to services. Omit them when the Agenda is off. A product cannot carry scheduling fields.

description.description: Plain text. Clients never make links clickable.

CatalogOrder.description: Every item ID in the catalogue, exactly once. Order determines sort.

Service.description: The same Catálogo item, with kind service and complete scheduling fields. Never a separate record or ID.

start.description: Local wall time in the business time zone. Start is inclusive; end is exclusive.

end.description: Local wall time in the business time zone. Start is inclusive; end is exclusive.

Availability.description: Several non-overlapping ranges per weekday are allowed. End must follow start. A missing weekday is closed.

start.description: Local wall time in the business time zone. Start is inclusive; end is exclusive.

end.description: Local wall time in the business time zone. Start is inclusive; end is exclusive.

TimeRange.description: End must follow start; ranges cannot overlap.

OverrideInput.description: Inclusive local dates; date_to must not precede date_from. Replaces weekly hours on those dates. Overlapping overrides for an agenda are rejected. Closed means no ranges.

AgendaBlock.description: Subtract this interval from the affected local days, creating or replacing hours overrides. End must follow start. Does not cancel bookings.

AgendaCloseDay.description: Close the local day by setting closed overrides. Bookings remain until the owner cancels them. No message is sent automatically.

Policy.description: Defaults follow ADR 0103. Request mode is reserved for slice 2. An empty reminder list disables reminders.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone. Changing it does not move existing UTC bookings.

oneOf.description: The signed-in customer. The API derives this ID from authentication for customer routes.
Owner-entered walk-in only. No chat card or reminders. Also used after account deletion (ADR 0103).

Booking.description: Minimal record (ADR 0102). No notes, address, allergy, message or other customer text. The only name is a name-only owner entry or a retained name after account deletion. End and hold expiry are server-derived. A held row expires five minutes after creation.

agenda_id.description: An eligible agenda ID or any. For any, the server chooses at hold time: least booked that local day, then agenda sort and ID.

BookingHold.description: Authenticated customer only. Customer, end, status and expiry are server-derived. Rate and open-booking limits apply.

OwnerBooking.description: Encaixe. Owner route only. Availability and exclusion rules still apply.

agenda_id.description: Agenda ID or any on customer routes; an agenda ID on owner routes.

BookingMove.description: Keep the same service. Replace atomically; a conflict leaves the original booking unchanged. The API derives the end and rechecks policy.

Slot.description: Free time only, with no booking or customer information. For any, agenda selection happens at hold time.

SlotDay.description: Date in the business time zone. Include the day with an empty list when full.

url.description: Returned once. Contains a 32-byte random token; only its hash is stored. Reissuing revokes the previous token.

AgendaFeed.description: Secret URL. Default ICS SUMMARY is Agendado. Never log the token or feed URL.

url.description: Secret ICS URL. Server resolves and checks every address and redirect; refuses private and link-local addresses; caps redirects, bytes and time. Never log this URL.

BusyImport.description: Fetch every 15 minutes; retain start and end only, never titles or descriptions. Do not return the secret URL.

PixChargeLink.description: An existing Pix charge from this same verified company. The API checks issuer, amount, state and recipient; a client-supplied ID never proves payment.

Queue.description: One queue per business per local day. Resets each day. Agenda bookings take priority at their booked time; the queue fills the gaps.

QueuePlace.description: No location, notes or customer description. Name-only entries are owner-created. Retain for 30 days after the queue day ends (ADR 0107).

QueueJoin.description: The authenticated customer is derived from the token; one active place per customer per business. An optional catalogue service improves the estimate.

QueueWaitRange.description: Upper bound must be at least the lower bound. Based on today’s served places or the service duration. An estimate, never an exact appointment time.

QueuePosition.description: Only this caller’s place. Position is zero when called; waiting positions start at one. Omit wait when there is insufficient data.

QuoteRequest.description: Only the fact of a request. Job descriptions, addresses and photos stay in the encrypted conversation.

oneOf.description: Owner chooses a catalogue item and its quoted unit price.
Business-authored text only, never a customer description.

QuoteLine.description: Immutable business-authored snapshot. Server calculates and rounds line totals to centavos, and rejects amounts outside safe integer range.

QuoteVersionInput.description: Owner-only. Validity entered as a local date is converted to UTC at the end of that local day. Optional visit_service_id opens the booking flow for that catalogue service.

QuoteVersion.description: Immutable; older versions stay readable. Total is calculated by the server.

Quote.description: A business may issue a quote only after this customer requested one. No customer free text or photos. Never infer paid from a quote or a linked Pix charge.

oneOf.description: Recheck availability and create the booking atomically with acceptance.
Create an order from the accepted immutable lines. Pix requires a verified CNPJ and an available charge flow.

QuoteAccept.description: Only the current, unexpired version can be accepted. A conversion failure leaves the quote unaccepted. Concurrent acceptances produce at most one resulting booking or order.

OrderLine.description: Immutable snapshot, calculated by the server. item_id may be absent only for a business-authored line converted from a quote.

OrderInput.description: Signed-in customer only. No customer ID, prices, total, address or notes. Fixed-price active products with amount_cents only; the server snapshots and calculates prices. from/on_request prices require a quote instead.

OwnerOrderInput.description: Owner-entered order; a name-only customer receives no push or chat card.

OrderRefusal.description: Fixed reasons only. Free text goes in the encrypted chat.

cutoff.description: Local wall time in the business time zone. Start is inclusive; end is exclusive.

OrderPolicy.description: Orders accepted only on these ISO weekdays and before the local cut-off time. An empty weekday list closes orders.

Order.description: Minimal order record. No address, notes or customer messages. One open order per customer per business; sent/accepted/ready are open. Payment choice and a charge link do not establish paid status. Retain for two years (ADR 0105).
